Finding:
↓ Overall Mortality
Higher alpha diversity prior to allo-HSCT was associated with a lower risk of mortality (HR 0.41; 95% CI 0.24–0.71)

↓ Overall Mortality
Patients with higher phylogenetic diversity had lower overall mortality rates (HR 0.37; 95% CI 0.18–0.77; p = 0.008)

↑ Overall Survival
Patients with higher intestinal diversity exhibited a higher probability of overall survival (88.9% ± 5.7% vs. 62.7% ± 8.2%; p = 0.011).

↓ Transplant-related mortality
Higher alpha diversity prior to allo-HSCT was associated with a lower risk of transplant-related mortality (HR 0.44; 95% CI 0.22–0.87).
